catalog: SELECT s.*,p.barcode FROM sale_stock s LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=s.productId
catalogPage: SELECT s.*,p.barcode FROM sale_stock s LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=s.productId
WHERE s.warehouse=@warehouse AND s.stock>0 AND (@afterId='' OR (s.name,s.id)>(@afterName,@afterId))
catalogBarcode: SELECT s.*,p.barcode FROM products p JOIN sale_stock s ON s.productId=p.id
WHERE p.barcode=@code COLLATE NOCASE AND s.warehouse=@warehouse AND s.stock>0 LIMIT 2
clients: SELECT id,name,phone,debt/100.0 AS debt FROM client_totals ORDER BY name
editClient: UPDATE clients SET name=trim(@name),phone=trim(@phone) WHERE id=@id
warehouseAccounts: SELECT id,name,amount FROM accounts ORDER BY name,id
warehouses: SELECT id,name FROM warehouses ORDER BY name,id
accounts: SELECT id,name FROM accounts ORDER BY name,id
